selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of scaly, crusted pink plaques involving the periorbital skin and biopsy results showing vacuolar interface dermatitis with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy are most consistent with Periorbital Discoid Lupus Erythematosus (DLE), a specific subtype of cutaneous lupus erythematosus.

rejected.label: Cutaneous lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of lupus nephritis and the presentation could fit within the broader category of cutaneous lupus erythematosus, the specific periorbital involvement and biopsy findings more precisely align with Periorbital Discoid Lupus Erythematosus (DLE).
